title: FlyRight — one place for the whole journey

headline: Every flight.
One place.
scenes.narration: Fly Right is the travel buddy you carry through a trip, and the journal you keep after it. Maja is flying Helsinki to Tokyo.

headline: Everything,
in fixed places.
scenes.narration: Open the trip: gate, seat, booking, and how far she has already flown.

headline: Each step,
as it happens.
scenes.narration: Each step, and room for the story.

headline: Number, scan,
or ticket.
scenes.narration: By number, by scan, or off a ticket.

headline: The day.
The airports.
scenes.narration: Or add it yourself — the day, the airports, and who sees it. Your circle gets a heads-up.

headline: Postcards
from the air.
scenes.narration: Updates is where your people are — postcards from friends still in the air, and friends just home.

headline: Follow it
step by step.
scenes.narration: Open one and follow their whole day.

headline: Who you follow.
Who follows you.
scenes.narration: Friends shows who you follow, and who follows you. Following is free.

headline: Every route.
On a real earth.
scenes.narration: Everywhere she has been sits on a globe we drew ourselves — twenty trips, twelve airports, ten countries.

headline: Your world,
as a poster.
bullets: A glow where you fly most
scenes.narration: Share it as a poster, with a glow over the routes she flies most.

headline: What the
airline owes.
scenes.note: Sample delay · eligibility depends on the circumstances
scenes.narration: Fly Right works out what the airline owes.

headline: Free to keep.
Pro to travel.
scenes.narration: Keeping flights and following people is free. Pro adds the live gate, terminal, delay and belt, the plane on its route, and postcards — your followers see it all free.

headline: A reminder,
not a paywall.
scenes.narration: Not flying yet? A reminder, not a paywall.

headline: Monthly. Yearly.
Lifetime.
scenes.narration: Monthly, yearly or lifetime, through Revenue Cat.

headline: Yours to send.
Yours to keep.
scenes.narration: You send the claim. You keep every cent.

headline: One place
for all of it.
scenes.narration: Fly Right. One place for the whole journey.
